groups.name: Drawing structures
groups.blurb: The everyday tools for getting a molecule on the page.

groups.name: Figures and layout
groups.blurb: What turns a structure into a journal-ready figure.

groups.name: Chemistry intelligence
groups.blurb: Whether the tool understands the chemistry, not just the lines.

groups.name: Files and exchange
groups.blurb: Getting work in and out, especially from ChemDraw.

groups.name: APIs and automation
groups.blurb: Driving the tool from code, scripts and AI agents.

groups.name: Embedding and extension
groups.blurb: Putting the editor inside other software, and extending it.

features.name: Single, double and triple bonds
features.test: Can a user draw and change these bond orders by hand?

features.name: Wedge, hash and wavy bonds
features.test: Solid wedge, hashed wedge and wavy bonds are drawable.

features.name: Dative, hydrogen and quadruple bonds
features.test: At least dative plus one other specialist bond type is drawable.

features.name: Choose double-bond side
features.test: User can set a double bond to left, right or centered.

features.name: Ring tools
features.test: Dedicated tools for common ring sizes, including aromatic rings.

features.name: Chair and Haworth rings
features.test: Dedicated chair or Haworth projection tools or templates.

features.name: Chain tool
features.test: Drag to create a zig-zag chain of chosen length.

features.name: Template library
features.test: Built-in structure templates beyond simple rings.

features.name: Save your own templates
features.test: User can save a drawing as a reusable template.

features.name: Group abbreviations
features.test: Labels such as Ph, Boc or OMe are chemically understood or expandable.

features.name: Charges, isotopes and atom labels
features.test: Charges, isotopes and arbitrary element labels can be set on atoms.

features.name: Radicals and lone pairs
features.test: Radical dots or lone pairs can be placed on atoms.

features.name: Keyboard drawing
features.test: Hover or point at an atom or bond and press a key to change it.

features.name: Lasso select and transforms
features.test: Lasso or free selection plus rotate, flip and resize.

features.name: Tilt drawings in perspective
features.test: A 2D drawing can be rotated in 3D or shown in perspective on the canvas.

features.name: Reaction arrows
features.test: Forward plus at least equilibrium, retrosynthetic or resonance arrows.

features.name: Curved mechanism arrows
features.test: Editable curved electron-pushing arrows, full or half head.

features.name: Machine-readable reactions
features.test: Reactants and products are stored as chemistry, such as RXN or reaction SMILES.

features.name: Atom mapping
features.test: Reaction atoms can be mapped manually or automatically.

features.name: Orbitals and symbols
features.test: Orbital shapes or a library of chemical symbols.

features.name: Rich text captions
features.test: Fonts, subscripts and superscripts in free text on the canvas.

features.name: Shapes, brackets and curves
features.test: Editable shapes plus brackets or free curves.

features.name: Align and distribute
features.test: Selected objects can be aligned or evenly spaced.

features.name: Group and ungroup
features.test: Objects can be grouped and moved together.

features.name: 2D structure cleanup
features.test: A command tidies bond lengths and angles of a drawn structure.

features.name: Journal drawing styles
features.test: Built-in presets such as ACS, JACS, RSC or Nature.

features.name: Reusable custom styles
features.test: Bond and font settings can be saved and reused.

features.name: Color control
features.test: Atoms, bonds or objects can be colored individually.

features.name: Color highlighting
features.test: Colored backgrounds or halos can highlight atoms, bonds or part of a structure.

features.name: Page layout and multipage
features.test: Page size control and more than one page in a document.

features.name: Imported pictures
features.test: Raster images can be placed in the drawing.

features.name: TLC plates and tables
features.test: Dedicated TLC or gel objects, or editable tables.

features.name: Structure checking
features.test: Valence or structure problems are flagged.

features.name: R/S and E/Z labels
features.test: Stereo descriptors are computed from the drawing.

features.name: Formula and mass
features.test: Molecular formula and mass are computed.

features.name: Property estimates
features.test: At least logP or TPSA is computed.

features.name: Name to structure
features.test: Typing a chemical name produces a structure.

features.name: Structure to name
features.test: A drawn structure produces a systematic name.

features.name: NMR prediction
features.test: 1H or 13C shifts are predicted from a structure.

features.name: R-groups and query structures
features.test: R-groups, atom lists or Markush structures.

features.name: Polymers and repeat units
features.test: Repeat units are represented, beyond a plain bracket drawing.

features.name: Peptides and nucleic acids
features.test: Sequence, HELM or monomer-based biomolecule tools.

features.name: Image to structure
features.test: A picture of a structure can be turned into an editable structure.

features.name: Online structure lookup
features.test: Structures can be fetched from PubChem or a similar database.

features.name: 3D model view
features.test: A structure can be viewed as a rotatable 3D model.

features.name: Crystal structures
features.test: CIF or crystal structures can be opened or drawn.

features.name: CDXML import and export
features.test: ChemDraw's XML format can be read and written.

features.name: CDX import and export
features.test: ChemDraw's binary format can be read and written.

features.name: MOL and SDF
features.test: MOL files can be read and written; note if SDF is missing.

features.name: SMILES
features.test: SMILES can be read and written.

features.name: InChI
features.test: InChI can be read or written.

features.name: RXN files
features.test: MDL RXN files can be read or written.

features.name: SVG export
features.test: Vector SVG export.

features.name: PDF export
features.test: Vector PDF export.

features.name: High-resolution PNG
features.test: PNG export at print resolution, 300 dpi or better.

features.name: Paste to and from ChemDraw
features.test: Structures stay editable when copied between this tool and ChemDraw.

features.name: Editable in Word or PowerPoint
features.test: A structure placed in Office can be re-edited.

features.name: Windows Office OLE
features.test: On Windows, a structure pasted into Word or PowerPoint can be double-clicked to edit it in the tool.

features.name: Python API
features.test: A documented Python package or binding drives the tool.

features.name: JavaScript or TypeScript API
features.test: A documented JS or TS API drives the tool from code. Embedding the editor is counted separately.

features.name: Command-line tool
features.test: A CLI can convert or render without the GUI.

features.name: AI agent control
features.test: An MCP server or documented agent interface.

features.name: Plugins
features.test: A documented extension mechanism.

features.name: Embed in your own app
features.test: A documented way to place the working editor inside another application or page. Office OLE is listed separately.

features.name: Built-in AI assistant
features.test: An assistant inside the product can propose or edit drawings.
